Mivo havalimanındaki görevliyi, doktoru: Mivo plays the airport clerk, the doctor or the interviewer. You speak out loud. When you stumble, Mivo fixes the sentence on the spot and explains why in your own language.

Ne çalışacağını seçmek için vakit harcam: No time wasted deciding what to study. The Today tab shows what's next.
Yıllarca İngilizce çalışıp gerçek bir ko: Many people study English for years and still freeze in a real conversation. Often the cause isn't a gap in grammar but never having rehearsed out loud. Spekvia lets you do that rehearsal somewhere safe: nobody judges you and mistakes are fine.

For the rest of the day, vocabulary, reading and podcast tasks wait for you at your level.
